event.juno_heart5.1.text: A steel sword. For the mines. You keep going down there, and you come up quieter every time. So. It's yours. Please take it.
A steel sword. For the mines, or the weeds, or the walk home after dark. Everybody's walking home earlier lately. It's yours.

event.next_door.0.text: Okay, okay, okay. Eyes shut. The light's been strange all week, but not in here. Not in here. ...Now!
event.next_door.0.why: the forge as the warm exception

event.hall_dance.8.text: Those door hinges are mine. My mark's on every pin. The door swung before anyone touched it tonight. Good hinge. Good hinge. I'm watching it anyway.

event.hall_dance.8.text: Those door hinges are mine. My mark's on every pin. It swung open by itself earlier. That's craftsmanship. Probably. Listen to it show off!

dlg.story.notes.juno.1.text: ...So. Now you know. Fifty-one notes, all me. People have been reading them twice lately, like they're checking the words stayed.
dlg.story.notes.juno.1.why: the village needing kindness more, unexplained

dlg.story.band.talk.1.text: Exhibit B: three anvils, a bucket, and Bram, who'll hit one thing, once. The square's been hushed all week. We're loud on purpose.
dlg.story.band.talk.1.why: noise against the hush; Bram's one-hit hinge kept

event.juno_heart4.setup.text: Okay, don't freeze — you look like you've been frozen all day. Come here instead. I have a surprise. The nice kind. Sticky, but nice.

event.juno_heart4.prank.text: Done! You're labeled! 'Guest (Excellent)'. The village could use more labels that stay true. Yours will.

event.juno_heart6.intro.text: Don't come in. Okay, come in. Shut the door — all the way, it's that kind of evening. I made something, it's crooked, and the quench barrel is looking at it.
event.juno_heart6.intro.why: the evening presses in; same job

event.juno_heart6.after.text: It's still crooked. It's still mine. ...The barrel didn't hiss. It always hisses. Always. Don't tell Bram yet. I have to pick the right day.
event.juno_heart6.after.why: repeat as distortion; triumph and secret kept

event.juno_heart6.after.text: It's still crooked. It's also still mine. That's new. Funny — the iron came off the rack cold today. Certain nights it does that. Don't tell Bram yet.
event.juno_heart6.after.why: cold-iron hint from my bible, never explained

dlg.juno.shoe.r0.text: ...Okay. Quiet's good. The anvil's quiet. The birds too, all week. Today the quiet can be ours.

event.juno_heart10.intro.text: Hold out your hands. Both. They're cold — okay, mine are warm enough for four. I cut my mark last night. A little anvil, a J hiding in it. You're first.
event.juno_heart10.intro.why: gentler at frightened; gift job intact

event.juno_heart10.intro.text: Hold out your hands. Both. I cut my mark last night. The fire stood straight up while I did it, like it was paying attention. A little anvil, a J hiding inside. You're first.
event.juno_heart10.intro.why: the fire listening, left as oddness

event.juno_courtship.intro.text: Deep breath. Mine, not yours. I made a list. 'Reasons I Like the Farmer.' Forty items. Item forty is 'comes back, even on the strange days.' So. Would you court me?
event.juno_courtship.intro.why: the ask unchanged; she names the strange days kindly

dlg.juno.partners.r2.text: Okay. Yes. Hands. Yours are cold. Mine never are — forge perk. We'll average out. Don't let go.
